loan.rationale: Buy mode models the financing a service member most often uses: a VA-guaranteed loan with no down payment and no mortgage insurance. The funding fee is financed into the loan, as is common.
loan.rate_window: same months as the B9 ZHVI window (default: the BAH calendar year)
sources: VA funding fee, purchase loans, first use with less than 5% down: 2.15% (rates effective 7 Apr 2023). https://www.va.gov/housing-assistance/home-loans/funding-fee-and-closing-costs/
Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey, 30-year fixed (A7)
loan.notes: Members with a service-connected disability rating are exempt from the funding fee; subsequent-use VA loans pay 3.3% with less than 5% down. Both are single-parameter sensitivity checks.

property_tax.source: NAHB analysis of the 2024 American Community Survey: national average effective property tax rate on owner-occupied homes, $8.88 per $1,000 of value (eyeonhousing.org, Nov 2025).
property_tax.notes: State effective rates range from about 0.31% (Hawaii) to 1.79% (Illinois), so a national rate misstates cost in both directions. A8 should replace this with a state or county rate.

insurance.source: NAIC average HO-3 homeowners premium, data year 2022, as reported by the Insurance Information Institute (latest NAIC data available as of its May 2025 study).
insurance.notes: A 2022 national average understates 2026 premiums, which have risen since, and ignores state and hazard variation. Flat dollars rather than a share of value, because premiums track replacement cost and regional hazard more than market value.

warnings: property_tax uses a national placeholder (placeholder until A8)
insurance uses a national placeholder (placeholder until A8)
